label: Three omission scopes of giving are strictly ordered; necessary production keeps only the weaker two
paraphrase: Analyst formulation on the shared causality frame. For every frame, world w and being g: total refraining (at some accessible world where g exists it gives nothing) implies withholding the whole actual roster (at some accessible world where g exists it gives none of the beings it gives at w, replacements allowed), which implies withholding each actual recipient individually (possibly at different worlds); a source that gives something at every accessible world where it exists never totally refrains; a fixed giver existing at w that gives something there withholds no recipient individually. Strictness controls: Van Cleve's frame with a giver withholds each recipient but not the whole roster and is necessarily productive; the replacement frame (g gives c at false and d at true) withholds the whole actual roster, does not totally refrain, is necessarily productive and satisfies #1897's ActualAbsenceByWithholding; the theist surrogate totally refrains. The registered STIT decision-frame controls pointwiseNotJoint and tiedNoEmptyChoice are included: each single recipient can be ensured absent while no cell omits all creation. Finite surrogates only.
